resourceAccounting.cacheBytes: Aggregate retained UTF-16 text bytes: token memo and context/property tracking <= floor(cacheBytes/2), whole-result cache <= floor(cacheBytes/4), argument cache <= floor(cacheBytes/4). All map generations, tuple/prediction entries, bucket keys and churn strings are included. Not total process or foreign JS heap bytes.
resourceAccounting.compiler: Shared UTF-16 input counters across theme getter results; definition depth/nodes, hyphen-path depth, radix recursion and actual character trie node allocation bounded. Fixed default typed tables exempt from custom input limits.
resourceAccounting.metadata: 8192 token slots, 32768 doorkeeper integers, optional 4096 churn slots; whole-result maps use bounded admitted generations and argument prediction entries <= caller maxNodes. Context/property tracking stops at source 4096 thresholds. ID guard temporary distinct sets execute only near 2^21, with keys bounded by tokens and tracked prior state. Temporary work/model copies bounded by products of caller limits.
resourceAccounting.callbacks: Original JsValue/function handles retained; JS objects and user callback allocations are opaque and outside Rust byte accounting.
